name: Bleed
summary: Can make enemies bleed, hurting them for a few turns.

name: Burn
summary: Can burn enemies, hurting them for a few turns.

name: Can't Miss
summary: Some of its attacks can't be dodged.

name: Death Effect
summary: Does something when this card is knocked out.

name: Dodge
summary: Can dodge enemy attacks.

name: Entry Effect
summary: Does something as soon as this card enters a fight.

name: Execute
summary: Can instantly finish off a weakened enemy.

name: Freeze
summary: Can freeze enemies.

name: Heal
summary: Can restore HP.

name: Hits All
summary: Can hit every enemy at once.

name: Ignores Defense
summary: Some of its damage ignores the enemy's damage reduction.

name: Immune
summary: Status effects like burn and stun don't affect this card.

name: Lifesteal
summary: Can heal itself from the damage it deals.

name: Not On Bosses
summary: Part of this card's ability doesn't work on bosses.

name: Once Per Battle
summary: Part of this card's ability can only happen once per fight.

name: One Per Party
summary: Only one copy can be in your party.

name: Pierce
summary: Some of its attacks also hit the enemy behind the target.

name: Poison
summary: Can poison enemies, hurting them for a few turns.

name: Revive
summary: Can come back after being knocked out.

name: Shield
summary: Can block hits with a shield.

name: Stun
summary: Can stun enemies so they skip a turn.

name: Summon
summary: Can bring extra cards into the fight.

name: Support
summary: Equip this card on a battle card to give that card its ability.
